s.how: Wilt 400g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g feta, chopped dill, 3 spring onions and 1 egg. Cut 6 sheets filo into strips, brush with 60g melted butter, add a spoon of filling and fold into triangles. Bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

s.note: the monster that grows more heads
s.how: Slice 2 blocks of haloumi, about 500g, into thick pieces. Griddle in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drizzle with honey, sprinkle with chilli flakes and thyme, and squeeze over lemon. Cook more as fast as it disappears.

m.note: a feast fit for the gods on Mount Olympus
m.how: Marinate 1kg diced lamb leg in lemon juice, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano and oil for 2 hours. Thread onto skewers and grill hot. Mix 300g Greek yoghurt with grated cucumber and garlic. Serve in 4 warm pita with tomato and red onion.

w.how: Mix 250g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of salt and 300ml warm water to a thick batter and rest an hour. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until puffed and golden. Toss in 150g warm honey with cinnamon and scatter over 60g chopped walnuts.

d.n: Olympus golden peach and honey fizz
d.how: Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp warm water until dissolved. In a jug mix 600ml peach nectar, the honey water, the juice of a lemon and half a teaspoon of orange blossom water. Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh peach slices, pour in the nectar to two thirds and top with chilled sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.
